b_replay_fact_as_a_branch.rule: browser_sha256 is the digest of the validated submission (acceptance.py:117), so a replay of one request id whose validated body differs in ANY member, this one included, is refused by lookup (acceptance.py:79-80).
b_replay_fact_as_a_branch.what_a_caller_sees: LIVE today: a body naming commentary_requested is refused before lookup, UNKNOWN_OR_SERVER_OWNED_FIELD, whatever the request id. BUILT: the first submission with a given request id fixes the member as sent (or absent); a second submission of that request id with the member added, dropped or changed is refused CHANGED_INPUTS_SAME_REQUEST_ID (public_reason_code INVALID_INPUT), nothing is written and nothing is queued; the same body again is answered from the stored record exactly as today. A client that retries after a timeout must therefore resend the SAME body: a form that adds the member to a request id it has already sent without it will be refused.
